problem_statement: When unpacking a DNS name from a record, the resolver does not correctly enforce the destination buffer size limit. A name composed of many labels whose total length (labels plus the dot separators and trailing terminator) exceeds the maximum query length is not rejected: instead of failing the unpack, the name is written past the end of its output buffer. dns_unpack_name() must return -EMSGSIZE whenever the unpacked name would not fit in the provided buffer, regardless of how the labels combine to exceed the capacity.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/lib/dns_resolve -s tests/net/lib/dns_resolve/net.dns.resolve -s net.dns.resolve -O twister-out --no-clean -W
